description: This file implements the client-side API for managing user authentication and authorization in etcd, including user creation, deletion, role management, and password changes, via HTTP requests.

classes.name: httpAuthAPI
classes.description: Implementation of the AuthAPI interface for enabling/disabling auth via HTTP.

classes.name: httpAuthUserAPI
classes.description: Implementation of the AuthUserAPI interface for user management via HTTP.

classes.name: authAPIAction
classes.description: Represents an HTTP action for auth API, including the HTTP verb.

classes.name: authUserAPIAction
classes.description: Represents an HTTP action for user management, including verb, username, and user data.

classes.name: authError
classes.description: Represents an error response from the auth API.

methods.name: v2AuthURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL for auth actions, appending the action and optional username.

methods.name: HTTPRequest
methods.description: Creates an HTTP request for the auth API action.

methods.name: ListUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all users.

methods.name: AddUser
methods.description: Adds a new user with specified username and password.

methods.name: GetUser
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific user.

methods.name: modUser
methods.description: Helper to modify user data via HTTP.
